method: Authenticated features and TXE-derived labels; independent mature-sample release schedule, little-endian sample/XY hashes, augmented least-squares Ridge, training-fitted risk median, every prediction and every cutoff replay with future schedules/features removed.
limitations: Uses the previously independently audited fixed label definitions; does not independently reconstruct original TXE fills here.
Runtime feature recomputation, candidate payload identity and account execution require their separate audits.
Thirty initial matured samples and selected mechanisms use seen development data; prefix causality does not establish independent predictive validity.
